source.title: Single-trial dynamics of hippocampal spatial representations are modulated by reward value.

confidence_rationale: Reward value demonstrably reshapes the hippocampal place map itself -- faster reorganization/stabilization and value-selective replay when a goal carries large reward. This supports MECH-073's core: value/valence is woven into map geometry, not merely read off downstream. Confidence moderate: value modulates map DYNAMICS (rate, field appearance, replay), which is compatible with, but does not uniquely establish, valence being INTRINSIC to the map's geometric code as opposed to an extrinsically-driven reshaping.
failure_signatures: Value modulation of map reorganization could be driven by an extrinsic reward/dopamine signal acting ON the hippocampus, which would be consistent with a 'downstream value applied to a value-free map' account -- the very alternative MECH-073 denies. The study shows value affects the map but not that value is represented within the map's own geometry.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The size of reward at a goal location modulates single-trial reorganization and stabilization of the hippocampal place map and biases replay toward behaviorally relevant experiences.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports MECH-073: valence/value is entangled with hippocampal map formation and geometry (reward reshapes which fields form and stabilize), consistent with valence being intrinsic to map geometry rather than applied purely downstream.
mapping.mapping_caveat: 'Value modulates the map' is weaker than 'valence is intrinsic to the map geometry': the modulation could originate from an extrinsic value signal. The entry is scored supports-but-not-decisive precisely because it cannot separate intrinsic-geometry from extrinsic-modulation-of-geometry.
mapping.source_context: Rat dorsal CA1 tetrode recordings during place-reward association learning with varying reward size.

confidence_components.notes: Strong electrophysiology; mapping fidelity capped because 'value modulates map dynamics' underdetermines 'valence is intrinsic to map geometry'.
